fixed_findings: Direct final-name writes could leave a partial report after a mid-write OSError.
Assigning in-memory context before MemoryStore.commit could expose COMPLETED and break failure recovery.
The isolation docstring overstated Python monkeypatch coverage; narrowed it to known entry points.
fixes: Write a temporary file, publish with exclusive os.link, and clean the created temporary artifact on tested failures.
Commit next context before assigning it; on tested final-commit failure clean the newly published artifact and report refs, then record FAILED.
Document that the monkeypatch guard is not an OS-level sandbox.
